newsitem.title: USA: Argentine minister assures Jews on bomb probe.
newsitem.headline: Argentine minister assures Jews on bomb probe.

text.p: Argentine Interior Minister Carlos Corach told a Jewish group on Wednesday that authorities are convinced that the 1992 bombing of the Israeli embassy in Buenos Aires was the work of a car bomb and that investigators have traced money used in connection with the explosion.

The World Jewish Congress said that Corach told a meeting of the group that the interior ministry rejects a recent Supreme Court finding that the explosion which killed 29 people took place inside the building.
Instead, he said, investigators had found a crater that indicated that a bomb went off in a van and that they found pieces of the van.

A WJC spokesman said Corach told the group that money connected to the explosion -- presumably for the hiring of the van -- had been traced and that some of the bills contained handwritten Arabic script.
No one has been arrested in connection with the Israeli embassy bombing.
